info.name: SKYO · Flights (aviationstack + SKYO API)
info.description:
1) aviationstack direct — every documented v1 endpoint with all parameters (each successful call uses 1 of your monthly requests; errors are free).
2) SKYO flight API — public, traveller (cookie session) and agent endpoints.
Set aviationstack_key in the environment, never in the collection.
